subject: Invoice submission workflow - required capture fields, SLA, and email fallback routing
messages:
From: Tidewater Logistics <billing@tidewaterlogistics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Cain <susan.cain@tidewaterlogistics.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New supplier — initial invoice sample and question on where to send

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the warm onboarding call earlier. Attaching our invoice sample (invoice_sample_2107.pdf) — please confirm the preferred submission path for Redwood: your vendor portal URL or sending invoices to an email address.

Quick context: our billing team currently posts invoices to portals when available, but many of our customers still allow invoice-by-email. We need to know:
- Preferred ingest channel (portal vs email)
- Exact capture fields you require (we have multiple templates internally)
- Any special acknowledgement headers you need included so our system can reconcile (e.g., an ack id or header)

Also attached is the sample invoice showing multiple line items (freight + hardware + one-off install). One question: do you need PO stamping or a specific SKU/line mapping for each line item?

Appreciate a short checklist we can follow so our ERP sends everything correctly.

Best,
Susan Cain
Billing Manager
Tidewater Logistics

Attachment: invoice_sample_2107.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tidewater Logistics <billing@tidewaterlogistics.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier — initial invoice sample and question on where to send

Hi Susan — great to hear from you and thanks for the sample. Short answers up front:
- Preferred path: vendor portal (https://app.redwood.com/vendor/portal) for production invoices.
- Fallback: invoice-by-email is supported but we require a structured subject line and additional headers to automate ingestion.
- PO process: Redwood requires a valid PO number on every invoice line for goods. Services may be handled as exceptions but should be pre-approved.

Checklist (please add these fields to your template or our onboarding form):
1) Redwood PO Number (string, required)
2) Redwood Account Code (6-digit alphanumeric) — we’ll supply after onboarding
3) Line-level description (max 240 chars) and quantity/unit price
4) Line-level SKU or internal billing code (if available)
5) Tax/VAT amount and indication whether prices include tax
6) Remit-to address and bank details (for ACH)
7) Invoice total, currency, invoice date, and unique invoice number

Fallback-by-email rules (if portal is not available):
- Send to: invoices+tidelog@redwood.com
- Subject format: Invoice | PO<PO_NUMBER> | Tidewater Logistics (example: Invoice | PO123456 | Tidewater Logistics)
- Please include header: X-Redwood-Invoice-Ack: {vendor_ref} — we will reply with an ack id within SLA window.

SLA and processing expectations:
- Acknowledgement: within 48 business hours (automated reply with ack id)
- Validation exceptions: within 5 business days with a reconciliation ticket
- Payment terms: Net 45 by default (will be listed on the PO)

I attached our vendor onboarding form — vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx — which lists the fields above and sample CSV mapping you can use for bulk invoices. If you can complete that and upload to the portal, procurement will provision your account and share the account code.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Mina (procurement) to confirm exceptions for services and PO stamping rules.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (Excel, 54 KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tidewater Logistics <billing@tidewaterlogistics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier — initial invoice sample and question on where to send

Hi Susan — quick procurement notes to help your ERP team:
- PO stamping: Redwood’s AP system will match on PO Number + Invoice Number. If a PO is present we prefer line-level PO mapping (PO12345-1, PO12345-2) for complex shipments.
- One-off professional services: if you don’t have a PO, please indicate “Services — pre-approved” and copy your Redwood account manager in the invoice email. We’ll route to a manual queue.

CSV sample layout we accept (columns):
VendorName,VendorTaxID,InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,Currency,TotalAmount,PO_Number,LineNumber,SKU,Description,Qty,UnitPrice,TaxAmount,RemitBank,RemitAccount
(see attached sample_csv_layout.csv)

Email fallback notes: if portal uploads are not possible for your team, use the invoices+tidelog@redwood.com address and include the Subject format Marcus mentioned. Bcc is discouraged — it breaks automated parsing.

If you expect to send recurring monthly invoices, let us know and Procurement can enable a recurring vendor profile to bypass manual review.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample_csv_layout.csv (CSV, 3 KB)

From: Susan Cain <susan.cain@tidewaterlogistics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier — initial invoice sample and question on where to send

Thanks Marcus / Mina — couple of follow-ups from our billing team after reviewing the checklist:
1) Line description length: our ERP truncates descriptions to 120 chars by default. If Redwood accepts 120 chars we can map directly; if you need longer we’ll request a schema change.
2) VAT handling: we are VAT-registered in EU; invoices will sometimes show VAT separately. Do you want VAT on separate lines or aggregated?
3) Bank details: is ACH preferred for US payments? We can provide both ACH and wire details.

Example lines from our system (we included a short paste below):
- PO: PO98765 | Line 1 | HDR-100 | Rack mount kit | Qty 2 | $1,200.00
- PO: PO98765 | Line 2 | FRT-22 | Freight — expedited | Qty 1 | $250.00

We can complete the vendor onboarding form this afternoon once we confirm description length and VAT presentation.

Best,
Susan

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tidewater Logistics <billing@tidewaterlogistics.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier — initial invoice sample and question on where to send

Quick check-in — Susan, we discussed internally and confirm:
- 120 char line descriptions are acceptable for now. If you can include the full description in a separate CSV field we will retain that for our records.
- VAT: please show VAT as separate line items (tax_amount column) and include the VAT registration number in the remit block.
- ACH is preferred for US payments; Wire is accepted if you include bank SWIFT and IBAN.

Next steps for Tidewater:
1) Complete vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and upload to the portal (preferred) or reply to invoices+tidelog@redwood.com with the subject format described.
2) If you upload, include the CSV mapping for bulk invoices so AP can map fields automatically.
3) We’ll validate and send a provisioning email with your Redwood account code within 2 business days of receiving the completed form.

Marcus / Mina — feel free to add anything I missed. Susan — looking forward to the completed form.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
